Subject: Runway credit request for overnight soak (Streamlytics POC)

Markus / Marissa,

Thanks again for the help last week. We're gearing up to run a 36–48 hour overnight soak to validate throughput and p95 latency under concurrent traffic. Quick summary: 

- Goal: 10k concurrent requests over a 12-hour window nightly, sustained for 36–48 hours (end-to-end soak).
- Target SLOs for the test: p95 < 250ms, p99 < 600ms.
- Model: open-llama-70b-quant (through Redwood hosted endpoints).
- Expected token consumption: ~120k tokens per night (~360k tokens total for full run).

We are nearly ready to kick off but hit our trial quota limit. Can Redwood provision a temporary runway credit while we complete this soak? Ideally a $4k–$5k promotional allocation or equivalent token top-up that expires after the test window. This is strictly for validation — we want to confirm performance and finalize a sizing recommendation.

Attached is our soak plan with concurrency profile and traffic schedule. Happy to jump on a 15‑minute call if you need more details. We aim to start the first window on Tuesday night (3/7) PST.

Appreciate the quick turn here — this test will directly inform our capacity ask for dedicated.

Best,
Alex Jenkins
Head of Platform Engineering
Streamlytics

Alex — thanks for the plan and clear numbers. Quick questions to make the approvals clean: 

- Confirm the total requested token-equivalent or dollar amount you prefer (you mentioned $4k–$5k). state a single ask (helps us expedite).
- Confirm whether test traffic will include any PCI/PII-sensitive payloads (affects Private/Hosted approvals).
- Do you want the allocation to cover model changes (if you switch to a smaller quantized variant mid-run)?

Internally I'll route this to promo approvals and billing. Priyom, Monica — looping you both for a provisional 48-hour promotional allocation and to estimate how we should structure an expiring voucher (start/end timestamps). If we can't do full $5k, what do we recommend as a fallback amount that still lets them validate p95/p99?

If you can confirm the single-dollar ask (e.g., $4,000), I'll push this as an expedited promo. Also, what timezone should we use as the official start (Alex suggested 3/7 PST).

—Markus
